title: w-dc76 post-restart live read-only explorer check
outcome: After w-dc7657cc3529 has landed and the host runs a build containing it, a live check shows that a Claude explorer delegation spawned with writePolicy readOnly is enforced as read-only by the host.
acceptance: Live, on the installed CLI: a Claude explorer delegation with readOnly, in a scratch workspace whose project settings allow Bash(git add:*) and Bash(node:*), has both commands refused by the host, and the workspace shows no mutation. This mirrors the evidence in delegation-99c215cd, which showed the defect.
